text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Satsuki Sho, the first race of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Mejiro Ardan has set the Japanese Derby as her goal, she's always held a strong desire to leave a mark on the Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And since the Satsuki Sho is the first race of the tour, we can't possibly pass up this opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knowing her body's current state, I'm confident she'll be able to put up a good fight at the Satsuki Sho, and then take on the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Even in the waiting room, I can feel the tension in the air. So this is what it's like to attend a Classic G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll be quite fine. I'm prepared both mentally and physically.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As the first step to outshining my older sister, I wish to prove myself at the Satsuki Sho today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Please watch me as I run.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho—the first race of the Classic Triple Crown—will be starting shortly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (So this is the Satsuki Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (The feverish cheering, the sheer passion of the racers, this crushingly heavy atmosphere…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (And yet, amidst it all, I can still feel the beating of my heart—a pulse that this world shall never drown out.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …My older sister must have stood atop such stages too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow… Ardan's focus is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But don't forget about me! I'm going to deliver a standout performance today, and then proceed right on to the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Both Chiyono O and Ardan seem to be in top form.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ardan, in particular… From up close, that concentration of hers is truly staggering.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A worthy opponent indeed!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Though it does somewhat vex me that she's paying me no mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …I'll show you, Ardan. I'll show you a performance you can't ignore!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: To best the crown jewel of the Mejiro family, and outdo her brilliance…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall run with all I have.
